llm.summary: DFH was in the laggards lane and was stopped out with negative excess return, classified as an idiosyncratic break. This was a failure but with a clean process.
llm.root_cause: DFH was in the laggards lane and was stopped out with negative excess return, classified as an idiosyncratic break. This was a failure but with a clean process.
llm.lesson: The laggards lane reversal signal for DFH failed, indicating the conditioning for reversal is not robust here.
llm.engines_credit: The laggards reversal book missed a continued downtrend despite the signal.
alternate_explanations: The stock continued to fall due to sector weakness or no reversal catalyst.
The signal was based on stale data.

signal_hypotheses.feature: Proportion of laggards entries that continue to break, within 10 days
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compute for laggards lane, fraction of picks with further negative excess return 10 days post-entry
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: A high fraction indicates the reversal signal is weak and conditioning needs review
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: If only a small fraction continue to break, reversal signal is working and DFH is an outlier.
